Subject: DSA
Topic: Arrays & Two-Pointer
Difficulty: 2/5
Question: Given an unsorted array of integers and a target sum, how would you determine if any two elements add up to the target?
Candidate Answer: We can maintain a Hash Set or Hash Map while iterating through the array. For each number x, check if (target - x) is already in the set. If so, return true. Otherwise insert x. This takes O(n) time and O(n) space.
